hardware: yoda, physical device 1, AMD Radeon Pro V620 gfx1030
ggml_patch_application: setup.py patch_llama_cpp applies third_party/llama.cpp-patches in sorted order; CMake only consumes the selected source. vendor-patch-check.json verifies 0001..0007 with fuzz=0 from the exact pin and byte identity of all six affected kernel files.

microbench_shapes.chunk_interpretation: Mean counts for 2048/4096/8192 token chunks at 10 of 512 experts, not a recorded live routing histogram.
microbench_shapes.timing: Existing hip_prefill_expert_bench: minimum of five timed calls after warmup, host wall time around synchronized GPU calls. Repeat files provide interleaved A/B controls. Synthetic random-byte weights with bounded block scales; existing FP64 checks and full-output comparisons.

owner_asm_zero_heads.verdict: Slower in the first sweep. Keep off; do not infer a native gain from the owner's vendor-MMQ gain.

scheduler_visible_zero_heads.method: sdot4 clamp=true only for compile-time zero accumulator; four signed-byte products sum within [-65024,65536], so saturation cannot change the result. The intrinsic preserves scheduler latency knowledge.
scheduler_visible_zero_heads.pack: IQ3_S pack for the IQ2_S GU gain; initial apparent Q4_0 gain disappeared in interleaved repeats.

IQ_tile_heights.verdict: Retain the live TJ20 at 4096/8192 chunk means; larger native accumulator arrays did not help. Native Q4_0 and IQ4_NL already carried unsuccessful J64 trials, so no blind J128 extension was made to those kernels.

IQ4_NL_perm_dispatch.issue: STRATA_PF_NL_PERM=1 was only honored at TJ32, not the live IQ3_S config's TJ20.
IQ4_NL_perm_dispatch.fix: Honor the existing permutation flag for every existing tile height.
IQ4_NL_perm_dispatch.timing_limit: No interleaved repeat before the GPU cutoff; timing is preliminary.

native_IQ_Q8K.adaptation: Same common fp32 activation scale per 128 values, but native IQ integer sub-block scales accumulate before one float fold. Not the owner's K-quant-only callback copied under an IQ type.
native_IQ_Q8K.tested_path: Gather quantizer; this is the gfx103x live default. Scatter cases added to existing test but not rebuilt/run after the 10:15 cutoff.

MMQ_vector_copy.alignment: Explicit int4 LDS base; even J; 144-byte activation rows; int2 source alignment checked at launch; partial thread groups copy only logical words. Existing K tails and all local patches retained.
MMQ_vector_copy.verdict: Exact, but about 7% less throughput in this Q4_K microbench. Keep opt-in pending owner end-to-end test.

owner_wide_J.gate: Original non-fallback RDNA2 configs, 256 threads, I128, unchanged K iteration. Current group's p.max_rows continues to select the width; no total_rows/nchannels mean heuristic was substituted.
owner_wide_J.validation: Wider-J plus vector-copy passed the K-quant test's 33 FP64 cases including raw/saturated weights, fallback rows, uneven experts, all four added J widths and padded K tails.
owner_wide_J.remaining: Isolated J64-vs-wide-J bitwise/speed A/B was not run before the GPU cutoff. Expected exact from unchanged K accumulation order, but do not label this isolated control verified yet.

decode_results.owner_asm_expert_heads: Complete existing decode lab --hash output byte-identical across all supported type pairs, T1..8, three routing plans; compared control and experts-dotz snapshots.
decode_results.dense_clamp: hip_mmvq_row_parity passed 3840 layout runs and 96 projection-set launches.
decode_results.head_clamp: hip_head_parity 8192 passed 608 cases, including 76 draft-head cases and 400 staged-sampler cases; 0 mismatches.
decode_results.Q3_K_scale: One missed native IQ Q3_K scale multiply was replaced with strata_smul; ISA shows four dot-loop v_mul_lo_u32 replaced by four v_mul_i32_i24. Two address products remain. This pack's routed experts do not use Q3_K.

native_Q8K.scope: Qwen3.8 native Q4_K/Q5_K gate-up with Q5_1/Q8_0 down, 2560/640 geometry, gfx103x only
native_Q8K.adaptation: Native API receives q8_1, so the prototype re-quantizes its reconstructed activations to common fp32/128 scales. It is an additional rounding step, not the owner's original-float quantizer. Temporary activation rows alias H+HQ until GU completes; no extra persistent scratch.
native_Q8K.speed_status: Not timed before the cutoff; not ranked for adoption.

attention_and_checkpoint_scope.prompt_attention: Existing STRATA_PA_DOT4 already keeps K int8. Zero-head variants were built for its shared dot helper; independent attention performance/quality test remains pending.
attention_and_checkpoint_scope.decode_attention: qsa_decode_attn.cu and qsa_pattn.cu still widen q8 K in score loops. Identified, not ported: coordinator explicitly moved decode-only work after prompt work.
attention_and_checkpoint_scope.checkpoint: llama-server checkpoint code is not linked into Strata. Native STRATA_CKPT_POOL and READY reuse checkpoint vectors/pages; STRATA_CKPT_ASYNC also has reusable pinned staging. Fresh vectors still zero on resize; no new global allocator was imported.

quality.procedure: Owner keeps frozen config/placement, sends same fixed 36K prompt with max-new=1 for baseline and switch, then compares <prefix>.0 files. Reports full-vocabulary KL(ref||run), top1/top20 overlap and raw-logit error without changing KV/expert settings.

remaining: Owner full-model prompt speed and quality A/B of pinned binaries; no model was loaded by this lane.
Isolated wider-J bitwise/speed check and interleaved IQ4_NL timing.
Scatter-specific Q8K cases were added after cutoff; compile/run still pending.
Independent expert-clamp, attention-clamp, dense/head speed benchmarks; native Q8K decode timing.
No native dense Q8K layout, int8 decode-attention port, routed-tile compaction, new narrow-warp heuristic or four-block plain-Q8_1 layout control was implemented.
HIP gfx1030 built and tested; CUDA and other HIP architectures not built.
large_temporary_data: Raw parity/ISA/dump buffers were discarded after the coordinator's tmpfs cleanup. Retained logs, numeric-error summaries and ISA counters are here. Regenerate future large buffers under worktree/build on disk, not /tmp.
